records.text: Fat loss requires a sustained energy deficit over time; exercise increases energy expenditure and supports health, fitness and lean-mass retention, but food intake and adherence also matter.
Resistance training during weight loss helps preserve or build strength and lean tissue; adequate protein and a manageable rate of loss support this goal.
Body recomposition is possible, especially in beginners, returning trainees and people with higher starting body-fat levels, but the rate and likelihood vary.
Spot reduction is not a reliable fat-loss strategy. Training a body part strengthens it; it does not selectively remove nearby fat.
Do not promise a target body weight, visible abs, a fixed weekly loss rate or a transformation deadline. Use trend data and user wellbeing.
